method: scripts/quality/audit-action-handlers.py static pass, then per-candidate source reading. Rules applied: action_id() outside tests = handler; TextEntry.opened_by = handled by the SDK entry field; page_turns ids dispatch to fn on_page_turn; is("x") closures and action_id(variable)/format! loops are dynamic dispatch; ScreenBuilder::new ids are screen ids, not actions; storage keys, task kinds and status strings are not actions.

flashcards.next: page_turns id dispatched to fn on_page_turn (line 1112)
flashcards.previous: page_turns id dispatched to fn on_page_turn (line 1112)

grimoire.items: tab id, handled via kind.action() dispatch loop (line 1171)

habits.local: settings row id, handled via schedules.find(action_id(action)) loop (line 457)

parser.slots-page-back: page_turns id dispatched to fn on_page_turn (line 759)
parser.slots-page-next: page_turns id dispatched to fn on_page_turn (line 759)

post.gateway-url: text field id, not an action

sidekick.allow: handled via action_id(choice) loop over [ALLOW, DENY, IGNORE] (line 821)

gallery.UNRESOLVED: button-one, button-two, button-primary, button-second, button-off, button-primary-off, ctx-one, ctx-one-menu, ctx-two, ctx-two-menu, grp-save, hold-here, menu-one, picture-one, picture-two, reading-controls, state-browse, state-report, state-retry are specimen controls on component demo pages with exactly one source reference (registration only). button-off/button-primary-off/button-second-off demonstrate disabled states, where inert is correct. The rest may be intentional specimens (a style showcase need not navigate) or dead demo controls; this is a design judgment for the owner, not a mechanical call.

summary: 50 app sources audited (44 catalog apps minus zotero-reader, plus shared examples). After per-candidate verification, no dead control was found in any shipped app: every candidate is handled through a dispatch idiom the static pass cannot see (is() closures, action_id loops, on_page_turn, opened_by) or is not an action at all (screen ids, storage keys, task kinds, status strings, field ids). Only gallery's specimen controls remain, pending an owner design judgment.
